title: Fuel-fired Kiln
pages: Build a crusher, sieve, refractory mixer, ash bellows, clay extruder and quern first. Crush raw copper into at least five copper grit (four for the mixer, one for the kiln), then sieve eight pointed dripstone into two screened flux. In the mixer, combine four sand, two clay balls and 500 mB water to make two refractory binder; one is needed here. Mill two wheat in the quern for one Ground Meal. Place an Astral Font beneath open sky at night and spend 40 lumen with an amethyst shard to make a Night Sigil. Craft the kiln as XRM / CFN / SGS (X formed firebrick, R refractory binder, M Ground Meal, C copper grit, F furnace, N Night Sigil, S screened flux, G temper ash). Plain brick, raw clay, copper ingots and unscreened stone cannot replace these materials. All six t0 machines and a lumen rite gate the thermal workshop.

Right-click to open. Left slot: material; middle: solid fuel; right: result; narrow far-right slot: replaceable Kiln Heating Coil. Coal, charcoal and ordinary containerless furnace fuels work. Lava buckets and other fuels with crafting remainders are rejected. Shift-click fuel goes to the middle slot, and shift-clicking a coil installs it; place logs manually in the left slot to make charcoal.

Without a coil, the firebox stops at 900 heat. Craft a Kiln Heating Coil from four Annealed Copper, four copper ingots and one Formed Firebrick; anneal Copper Grit at 900 heat first. Install it in the far-right slot to raise the cap to 1000 for refractory charges. The coil is reusable and can be removed and replaced; removing it immediately cools the kiln to 900 and pauses high-temperature work. Fuel is not consumed to ignite a recipe beyond the current cap. Burning fuel adds 4 heat per tick up to the cap. Without a flame heat falls by 2 per tick. Firing advances only at the recipe temperature with enough input and output room. Remaining flame keeps burning even if blocked or idle. Residual heat can finish work without fuel. Removing material cancels work.

Top accepts material, horizontal faces accept fuel, bottom exports results. Six buttons cycle Off / In / Fuel / Out in world directions. Hoppers and Forge item handlers respect these settings; unsided access is material input only. The kiln uses fuel, not FE. Contents, fuel time, heat, work and ports survive saves. Breaking drops all four slots.

Fire copper grit at 900 heat for 200 ticks to make annealed copper. It can be recovered into a copper ingot in crafting; keep some for pressure equipment. Combine one iron block with two charcoal to make a Carburized Iron Charge. Fire the charge at 900 heat for 200 ticks to make eight steel billets; plain iron cannot substitute for the pressure press. Chromium and vanadium oxides do not reduce in a furnace: craft two of their grit with one aluminum grit into two thermite charges and fire each at the full 1000 heat (120 ticks for chromium, 160 for vanadium) to release one ingot. Tungsten instead uses carbon reduction: craft two Tungsten Grit with charcoal into two charges and fire each at 1000 heat for 180 ticks. Titanium cannot be carbon-reduced (it forms a brittle carbide), so it uses a chloride route: craft two Titanium Grit with one Purified Salts (Leaching Vat) and one charcoal into two Titanium Chloride Charges, then fire each at 1000 heat for 240 ticks to release one ingot. Zirconium uses a salt-flux aluminothermic charge instead of direct furnace smelting: combine two Zirconium Grit, one Aluminum Grit and one Purified Salts into two Zirconium Flux Charges, then fire each at 1000 heat for 280 ticks to release an ingot. Niobium is digested first: the Leaching Vat turns each Niobium Grit and 500 mB of water into a Niobium Oxide Cake, and the kiln reduces each cake at 1000 heat for 260 ticks into one Niobium Ingot. It also fires ceramics, dries plants, makes charcoal and cooks food. Batch bonus: four meat, fish, kelp, chorus fruit, logs, netherrack, iron or gold grit, stone or quartz blocks yield five products; two cactus or sea pickles yield three dyes. Clay, sand, sandstone, cobblestone, potatoes and wet sponges stay 1:1 to prevent recovery loops. JEI lists loaded recipes, temperatures, times and ingredients. With the coil installed, a Nichrome Charge (four nickel and one chromium ingot) fires at 1000 heat for 160 ticks into a Nichrome Billet for heating-element wire.

Datapacks add firing recipes with type arcana_industry:firing, ingredient (item or tag), optional count, result, duration (1..72000), temperature (1..1000) and optional integer priority. Higher priority wins, then ascending namespaced recipe ID. Same-ID definition changes reset work at reload. No other mod recipes are removed.
